description: This file defines the interface for embedded CPU simulation hooks in a Nordic Semiconductor environment, including function prototypes for initialization, boot, cleanup, interrupt handling, and testing, with visibility macros and linker section annotations.

methods.name: nsif_cpu0_pre_cmdline_hooks
methods.description: Hook called during early initialization before command line parsing.

methods.name: nsif_cpu0_pre_hw_init_hooks
methods.description: Hook called during initialization before hardware models are initialized.

methods.name: nsif_cpu0_boot
methods.description: Function to boot the CPU, expected to return after the CPU sleeps for the first time.

methods.name: nsif_cpu0_cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup function called when the simulation ends or exits.

methods.name: nsif_cpu0_irq_raised
methods.description: Function called when a hardware interrupt is raised.

methods.name: nsif_cpu0_irq_raised_from_sw
methods.description: Function called when an interrupt is raised from software context.
